title: Biyometrik giris (FaceID/TouchID)
purpose: Implements FR-E1-07: Opt-in biometric login prompt on first login for capable devices; password fallback on failure; enable/disable from Profile > Settings.

inputs.name: biometricCapability
inputs.note: face_id | touch_id | none -- determines prompt visibility

loading.description: Checking device biometric capability with a brief spinner.

ready.description: Biometric icon circle, benefits list card, Enable CTA button, and Skip link. Biometric type label adapts to device capability.

empty.description: Message explaining biometrics are not available on this device, with a Skip button to continue.

error.description: Banner explaining biometric setup failed, with option to retry or skip.

offline.description: Biometric setup is a local operation and works offline. No banner needed.
